Patch 0.1.27

Fix: updates install through Manafall.cmd so closing the game can no longer kill the installer.

What changed
- Apply writes a pending update, starts Manafall.cmd separately, then quits
- Manafall.cmd waits for the game to close, installs the zip, then opens Manafall again
- Desktop shortcut should point at Manafall.cmd (Create-Desktop-Shortcut refreshed)

If an update still fails, check Desktop\Manafall-patch-failed.txt and Game\patch-apply.log
